leakage.template_artifact_note: type6 questions share the 'Who is the person whose <attr> is' template (7/9 tokens), so raw-text token-Jaccard near-dups are expected artifacts; the binding criterion is exact question text and attribute-value overlap, both structurally 0 after pool dedup.

token_envelope.cap_note: B3 raw log deterministically prefix-capped to the B1 context size (prereg token_envelope: equal across arms).

discriminators.S_method: per-case answers normalized (casefold+whitespace), empty set -> '<EMPTY>'; aggregate count-vector cosine between arm and donor answer distributions, difference with paired bootstrap CI (prereg 'corr' reading = distribution cosine; secondary metric = mean per-case answer-set Jaccard difference). Deterministic, no embeddings.
